HALLUCINATIONS: None

The memo accurately reflects all key financial terms found in the source document. All major elements are properly supported:

- Borrower name (Vine Energy Holdings LLC), administrative agent (Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc.), and lender syndicate details are correct
- Amendment date (June 29, 2021) and original credit agreement date (December 30, 2020) are accurate
- Hedging covenant terms are precisely stated: 70% of natural gas production from Proved Developed Producing Reserves over 24-month periods
- Timing requirements (90 days after closing or 30 days after reserve report delivery) are correct
- Flexibility provisions regarding commercially reasonable efforts and market rates are accurately described
- Guarantor entities and collateral reaffirmation details match the source document
- The memo appropriately indicates "N/A" for financial terms not disclosed in the amendment (deal size, interest rate, maturity, etc.)

The memo does not contain any fabricated financial terms or details not present in the source document.

ANSWER: NO
MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo captures all the key financial terms that are available in the source document. While certain standard financial terms like deal size, interest rate, and maturity date are marked as "N/A" in the memo, this accurately reflects that these terms are not disclosed in this amendment document. Amendment No. 2 focuses specifically on modifying the hedging covenant requirements and adding definitions, rather than changing fundamental loan terms like principal amount or interest rates. All material terms present in the source document are properly captured, including:

- The specific hedging requirement (70% of natural gas production)
- The timing requirements (90 days after closing or 30 days after reserve report)
- The 24-month hedging period
- The flexibility provisions for market conditions
- All party names and their roles
- The effective date and original credit agreement date
- Collateral and guarantee confirmations
